recipes.title: Silky Poached Salmon, Dill & Chive Scrambled Eggs
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft scrambled eggs folded gently with flaky poached salmon, fresh dill, chives, and a squeeze of bright lemon.
steps: Whisk eggs lightly with 1 tbsp water and a pinch of black pepper.
Warm olive oil over low heat and fold eggs slowly 2 to 3 minutes until almost softly set.
Remove from heat, gently fold in flaked poached salmon, dill, chives, and lemon juice, and serve warm.
tips: Poached salmon gives all the brunch luxury of smoked salmon with a fraction of the sodium.
Ultra-soft, moist texture that is effortless to eat in the morning.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Avocado & Poached Salmon Toast
recipes.summary: Warm whole-grain toast spread with creamy ricotta and ripe avocado, crowned with moist flakes of poached salmon and lemon zest.

ingredient_details.item: fresh lemon zest plus a squeeze of juice

steps: Spread warm whole-grain toast with creamy ricotta cheese.
Arrange sliced ripe avocado and moist flakes of poached salmon on top.
Finish with lemon zest, a light squeeze of lemon juice, and fresh dill.
tips: Poaching extra salmon at dinner gives you a 5-minute omega-3 breakfast the next morning.
Creamy cottage cheese works nicely in place of ricotta.

recipes.title: Japanese Morning Poached Salmon, Rice & Spinach Bowl
recipes.summary: Classic Japanese-style nourishing breakfast bowl combining warm rice, tender poached salmon, wilted spinach, scallions, and a drop of sesame oil.
steps: Gently poach a salmon fillet in 1/2 inch barely simmering water covered for 7 to 8 minutes until flaky; steam spinach in the same pan the final minute.
Flake the warm salmon gently over a bowl of steaming rice alongside tender spinach.
Finish with sliced scallion, a light touch of soy sauce, and toasted sesame oil.
tips: Traditional Japanese fish-and-rice breakfasts provide calm, lasting energy with zero sugar crash.
Add a soft-boiled egg on top for a hearty morning meal.

recipes.title: Warm Green Tea & Poached Salmon Rice Bowl (Ochazuke)
recipes.summary: Soothing, hydrating Japanese comfort breakfast pouring freshly brewed mild green tea over warm rice, flaked poached salmon, and ginger.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked white or jasmine rice

steps: Brew 1 cup gentle green tea for 2 minutes and remove the bag or leaves.
Place warm rice in a deep bowl and top neatly with flaked poached salmon, grated ginger, scallion, and sesame seeds.
Pour the hot green tea around the edge of the rice and eat immediately with a spoon.
tips: Ochazuke is famously easy to swallow, hydrating, and calming on slow mornings.
Use decaf green tea or warm mild vegetable broth if avoiding caffeine.

recipes.title: Fluffy Poached Salmon, Spinach & Cottage Cheese Omelet
recipes.summary: Tender folded omelet filled with flaked poached salmon, creamy cottage cheese, and wilted baby spinach.
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of black pepper and pour into a lightly oiled skillet over medium-low heat.
When nearly set, arrange wilted spinach, flaked poached salmon, and spoonfuls of cottage cheese across one half.
Fold gently in half, warm 30 seconds, and slide onto a warm plate.
tips: Cottage cheese melts into a velvety creamy sauce inside the warm omelet.
Rich in morning omega-3s and gentle high-quality protein.

recipes.title: Savory Lemon-Dill Rolled Oats with Flaked Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Nordic-inspired savory morning porridge of rolled oats cooked in light broth, topped with tender poached salmon, cucumber, dill, and olive oil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats and vegetable broth 6 to 7 minutes until soft and creamy.
Stir in fresh dill and lemon juice and spoon into a warm bowl.
Crown with flaked poached salmon, finely diced cucumber, and a drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Combines Nordic whole-grain fiber with moist omega-3-rich salmon in one comforting bowl.
Swap cucumber for wilted baby spinach on cold mornings.

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Poached Salmon, Asparagus & Dill Egg Cups
recipes.summary: Tender crustless mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin with eggs, milk, finely chopped asparagus, and moist poached salmon.
steps: Heat oven to 350 F and lightly oil a 6-cup muffin tin (or line with parchment liners).
Divide flaked poached salmon and thinly sliced asparagus among the 6 cups.
Whisk eggs, milk, dill, and black pepper, pour evenly over top, and bake 15 to 16 minutes until softly set.
tips: Reheats in 20 seconds or tastes great cold straight from the refrigerator.
Use baby spinach if asparagus isn't in season.

recipes.title: Warm Sweet Potato Mash, Poached Salmon & Poached Egg Bowl
recipes.summary: Velvety warm mashed sweet potato topped with tender flaked poached salmon, a soft poached egg, olive oil, and snipped chives.
steps: Warm mashed sweet potato with olive oil and divide into two cozy bowls.
Arrange warm flaked poached salmon and a gentle poached egg over each bowl.
Finish with snipped chives and a bright drop of lemon juice.
tips: Naturally gluten-free, dairy-free, and wonderfully soft for effortless morning eating.
Microwave-steamed sweet potato takes only 5 minutes if you don't have leftovers.

recipes.title: No-Mayo Greek Yogurt, Lemon & Dill Poached Salmon Salad
recipes.summary: Freshly poached salmon flaked cool and folded with Greek yogurt, crisp cucumber, celery, fresh dill, and bright lemon juice.

ingredient_details.note: gently poached 9 minutes, cooled, and flaked

steps: Gently poach salmon fillets in 1 inch barely simmering lemon water covered 8 to 10 minutes until flaky; cool completely.
Whisk Greek yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, and fresh dill in a mixing bowl.
Fold in flaked poached salmon, cucumber, and finely diced celery; serve on soft greens or whole-grain toast.
tips: Freshly poached salmon salad tastes remarkably clean and mild compared to canned fish.
Keeps 2 to 3 days refrigerated for easy lunches.

recipes.title: Nordic Poached Salmon, Warm Baby Potato & Dill Plate
recipes.summary: Scandinavian lunch plate pairing moist poached salmon with tender boiled baby potatoes, thin cucumber ribbons, and lemon-mustard yogurt sauce.
steps: Boil halved baby potatoes 12 to 14 minutes until fork-tender while gently poaching salmon fillets 8 to 10 minutes in simmering water.
Stir Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, fresh dill, and lemon juice into a tangy creamy Nordic sauce.
Plate warm potatoes, flaky poached salmon, and cool cucumber slices with generous spoonfuls of sauce.
tips: A classic Swedish-inspired lunch that feels refined yet takes under 25 minutes.
Soft potatoes and moist poached salmon require minimal knife work.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon, Citrus, Avocado & Quinoa Lunch Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright grain bowl combining chilled poached salmon, fluffy quinoa, juicy orange segments, avocado, spinach, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Arrange baby spinach and cooked quinoa across the base of two shallow bowls.
Top neatly with flaked poached salmon, sweet orange segments, and cubed avocado.
Whisk extra-virgin olive oil and lemon juice together and drizzle over both bowls.
tips: Sweet orange segments complement buttery poached salmon and brighten every forkful.
Zero cooking needed when using pre-poached salmon.

recipes.title: French-Inspired Poached Salmon, Green Bean & Egg Salad
recipes.summary: Lightened Nicoise lunch featuring flaky poached salmon, tender steamed green beans, cherry tomatoes, soft-boiled egg, olives, and lemon vinaigrette.
steps: Steam green beans 6 minutes until tender, then rinse cool under cold water.
Arrange green beans, flaked poached salmon, cherry tomatoes, halved boiled eggs, and olives neatly on two plates.
Whisk extra-virgin olive oil and lemon juice with a pinch of black pepper and drizzle across both plates.
tips: Every item sits neatly in its own section so you can scoop easy, balanced bites.
Add tender butter lettuce leaves underneath if you want extra greens.

recipes.title: 12-Minute Miso, Tofu & Poached Salmon Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Restorative Japanese-style broth soup gently poaching salmon chunks alongside silken tofu, spinach, rice noodles, and sweet white miso.
steps: Simmer 3 1/2 cups water with grated ginger 3 minutes; add thin rice noodles and cubed salmon, lower heat, and gently poach 5 minutes until salmon flakes.
Slip in silken tofu and baby spinach for 1 minute, then turn off heat.
Dissolve white miso in a ladleful of warm broth, stir back in off-heat, and garnish with sliced scallions.
tips: Cutting salmon into bite-sized cubes lets it poach silky in just 5 minutes.
Soothing, dairy-free, and wonderfully gentle to swallow.

recipes.title: Tuscan White Bean, Poached Salmon & Parsley Bowl
recipes.summary: No-cook Mediterranean lunch uniting creamy cannellini beans, moist poached salmon, cherry tomatoes, parsley, olive oil, and lemon.
steps: Toss rinsed cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, and chopped parsley with olive oil, lemon juice, and cracked black pepper.
Gently fold in large moist flakes of poached salmon so they hold their shape.
Serve cool or at room temperature with crusty whole-grain bread if desired.
tips: Creamy beans and tender poached salmon make a high-fiber, omega-3-rich lunch with zero stove work.
Swaps in easily for classic tuna-and-white-bean salad.

recipes.title: Poached Salmon, Cucumber & Avocado Sesame Wrap
recipes.summary: Sushi-roll-inspired soft whole-wheat wrap filled with flaky poached salmon, creamy avocado, crisp cucumber strips, and sesame-rice vinegar dressing.
steps: Toss flaked poached salmon lightly with rice vinegar and toasted sesame oil.
Spread mashed avocado across both whole-wheat tortillas and top with baby spinach, cucumber, and seasoned salmon.
Roll tightly and slice diagonally into tidy halves.
tips: Gives all the fresh appeal of a salmon-avocado sushi roll using fully cooked, safe poached salmon.
Add a touch of pickled ginger on the side for brightness.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Orzo, Sweet Peas & Poached Salmon Bowl
recipes.summary: Soft spoonable whole-wheat orzo cooked with bright green peas, lemon zest, olive oil, and generous warm flakes of poached salmon.

ingredient_details.item: fresh lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Boil orzo 9 minutes, tossing in frozen green peas during the final 2 minutes; save 3 tbsp cooking water and drain.
Stir olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, dill, Parmesan, and splashes of cooking water into the warm orzo until silky.
Fold in warm or room-temperature flaked poached salmon gently and serve.
tips: Orzo and sweet peas scoop effortlessly with a spoon—great for calm, no-fuss midday eating.
Tastes delicious warm or chilled as a pasta salad.

recipes.title: Classic Lemon, Dill & White-Wine-Free Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth salmon fillets gently poached in fragrant lemon, shallot, black peppercorn, and dill broth, served with velvety yogurt-dill sauce.

ingredient_details.note: half sliced for poaching, half juiced for sauce

ingredient_details.item: thinly sliced shallot or sweet onion

steps: Simmer broth, lemon slices, sliced onion, half the dill, and black pepper 4 minutes in a wide skillet to infuse the liquid.
Lower heat so liquid barely shimmers, add salmon fillets, cover, and gently poach 8 to 10 minutes until flaky and opaque.
Stir Greek yogurt with remaining dill and lemon juice; lift salmon neatly onto warm plates and spoon the cool dill sauce alongside.
tips: Gentle poaching guarantees butter-soft salmon with zero fishy kitchen odor and zero oil splatter.
Serve alongside steamed asparagus and soft boiled baby potatoes.

recipes.title: Golden Coconut, Ginger & Turmeric Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Flaky salmon poached directly inside a soothing golden broth of light coconut milk, grated ginger, turmeric, lime, and baby spinach.
steps: Warm light coconut milk, 1/2 cup water, grated ginger, minced garlic, and turmeric in a wide skillet over medium-low heat for 3 minutes.
Nestle salmon fillets into the golden simmering broth, cover, and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly.
Tuck baby spinach into the warm broth 1 minute until wilted, finish with fresh lime juice, and spoon over steamed jasmine rice.
tips: Healthy fats from salmon and coconut milk help your body absorb turmeric gracefully.
One skillet, 20 minutes, and completely dairy-free.

recipes.title: Finnish Poached Salmon, Potato & Leek Soup (Lohikeitto)
recipes.summary: Beloved lightened Finnish salmon soup simmering baby potatoes, sweet carrots, and mild leek, then poaching silky salmon chunks right in the broth.
steps: Simmer diced potatoes, sliced carrots, sliced leek, and vegetable broth 12 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Lower heat to a gentle quiver, stir in milk and salmon chunks, and poach 4 to 5 minutes until salmon turns opaque and soft.
Fold in abundant fresh dill and ladle warm into cozy bowls.
tips: Using milk or oat milk instead of heavy cream keeps traditional Finnish lohikeitto light while staying velvety.
Every spoonful is soft, nourishing, and rich in omega-3s.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Olive Oil & Cherry Tomato Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Buttery tender salmon fillets gently poached in fragrant extra-virgin olive oil, bursting cherry tomatoes, garlic, lemon, and fresh basil.
equipment: Small oven-safe skillet or baking dish
steps: Heat oven to 300 F; nestle salmon fillets snugly in a small baking dish with cherry tomatoes, sliced garlic, and lemon slices.
Pour extra-virgin olive oil over the salmon and gently poach in the low oven 13 to 15 minutes until salmon yields softly to a fork.
Scatter fresh torn basil over top and spoon the sweet tomato-infused olive oil across the fish.
tips: Low-temperature olive oil poaching yields restaurant-silky salmon that never turns dry or chalky.
Serve with warm cannellini beans or soft crusty bread.

recipes.title: Ginger, Scallion & Soy Broth Poached Salmon with Bok Choy
recipes.summary: Clean East Asian supper poaching salmon and tender baby bok choy in aromatic ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil broth.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, soy sauce, and julienned ginger in a wide skillet for 3 minutes.
Lower heat, nestle in salmon fillets and halved baby bok choy, cover, and gently poach 8 to 9 minutes until fish flakes.
Transfer to shallow bowls with warm steamed rice, spooning aromatic broth, scallions, and toasted sesame oil over top.
tips: Poaching salmon and greens together keeps cleanup down to one pan.
Moist, fragrant, and mild with zero frying smoke.

recipes.title: Delicate Green Tea & Citrus Poached Salmon with Broccoli
recipes.summary: Light, antioxidant-rich salmon gently poached in freshly steeped green tea, orange peel, and ginger alongside tender steamed broccoli.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange peel plus 1 tbsp juice

steps: Pour freshly brewed green tea into a wide skillet with orange peel and ginger slices and warm to a bare simmer.
Add salmon fillets and small broccoli florets, cover, and poach gently 8 to 9 minutes until fish flakes and broccoli is bright and tender.
Plate warm and drizzle with olive oil and 1 tbsp fresh orange juice.
tips: Green tea subtly mellows salmon's richness and keeps the kitchen smelling fresh and clean.
Serve alongside jasmine rice or quinoa.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Fennel & Thyme Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Fragrant Provençal-style salmon fillets poached gently on a bed of thinly sliced fennel bulb, sweet orange juice, garlic, and thyme.
steps: Simmer sliced fennel, garlic, thyme, orange juice, and vegetable broth covered for 6 minutes until fennel turns tender.
Nestle salmon fillets atop the soft fennel, cover, lower heat, and poach 8 to 9 minutes until flaky.
Plate salmon over the sweet braised fennel, drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil, and spoon pan juices around.
tips: Poaching atop sliced fennel infuses the salmon gently while giving you a built-in side vegetable.
Pair with warm couscous or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Velvety Poached Salmon over Creamy Pea & Potato Mash
recipes.summary: Moist lemon-poached salmon plated over vivid green sweet-pea and Yukon Gold potato mash finished with olive oil and mint.

ingredient_details.item: finely chopped fresh spearmint or parsley

steps: Boil cubed potatoes 12 minutes, adding frozen peas for the last 2 minutes; drain and mash smooth with warm milk, olive oil, and spearmint.
Meanwhile poach salmon fillets gently in 1 inch barely simmering water with lemon juice covered for 8 to 9 minutes until flaky.
Serve tender poached salmon right atop the bright green potato-pea mash.
tips: Mashing sweet green peas right into potatoes boosts fiber and gives an effortless, ultra-soft dinner texture.
Kids and adults alike love the mild, cozy flavors.

recipes.title: Silky Lemon-Ricotta Pasta with Flaked Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Short pasta coated in a 2-minute no-cream lemon ricotta sauce with baby spinach and generous moist flakes of poached salmon.

ingredient_details.item: fresh lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest

steps: Boil short pasta per package directions, reserving 1/3 cup starchy pasta water; meanwhile gently poach salmon covered 8 minutes and flake.
Whisk ricotta, lemon juice, lemon zest, olive oil, and 3 tbsp hot pasta water in a warm bowl until velvety smooth.
Toss hot drained pasta and baby spinach into the creamy lemon ricotta until wilted, then fold in flaky poached salmon and cracked black pepper.
tips: Part-skim ricotta thinned with hot pasta water makes a silky cream-free sauce in 30 seconds.
Short shell pasta cups the sauce and salmon cleanly on a fork.

recipes.title: Fragrant Black Tea, Fresh Shiso & Ginger Poached Salmon Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Hydrating morning rice bowl bathing tender flaked poached salmon in freshly brewed smooth black tea with grated fresh ginger, aromatic shiso ribbons, and toasted sesame oil.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked jasmine or short-grain rice

steps: Brew 1 cup smooth black tea for 2 minutes so it stays gentle and non-bitter, then remove the tea bag or strain leaves.
Place warm rice in a deep bowl and arrange flaked poached salmon, grated fresh ginger, and snipped fresh shiso leaves on top.
Pour hot black tea gently along the rim of the bowl, finish with toasted sesame oil, and enjoy immediately with a spoon.
tips: Mild black tea creates a deeply cozy, hydrating broth that helps morning rice and salmon glide effortlessly.
Choose decaf black tea if you prefer a caffeine-free cup.

recipes.title: Silky Tarragon, Thyme & Walnut-Oil Poached Salmon Egg Scramble
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft morning scrambled eggs folded gently with flaky poached salmon, fresh tarragon, delicate thyme leaves, cracked black pepper, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water, fresh thyme leaves, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Warm 1/2 tsp walnut oil in a nonstick skillet over low heat and slowly fold the eggs 2 to 3 minutes until soft creamy curds form.
Take pan off the burner, gently fold in flaked poached salmon and chopped fresh tarragon, plate warm, and drizzle with the remaining walnut oil.
tips: Finishing with cold-pressed walnut oil adds nutty richness and complements salmon omega-3s.
Removing the pan just before eggs look dry guarantees a tender, moist scramble.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric, Celery & Poached Salmon Warm Barley Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Savory warm pearl barley simmered with finely diced celery stalk, golden turmeric, cracked black pepper, fruity olive oil, and tender flakes of poached salmon.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalk in half the olive oil over medium-low heat for 3 minutes until sweet and tender.
Add cooked pearl barley, vegetable broth, ground turmeric, and cracked black pepper and simmer 7 minutes until velvety.
Spoon into warm bowls, top gently with flaked poached salmon, and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
tips: Pearl barley offers gentle beta-glucan fiber that pairs beautifully with savory poached fish.
Reheat extra cooked barley on busy mornings for a 12-minute hot breakfast.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Sweet Orange & Fresh Basil Poached Salmon Toast
recipes.summary: Toasted whole-grain bread layered with creamy ricotta, moist flakes of poached salmon, sweet diced navel orange, torn fresh basil, extra-virgin olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Stir fresh orange zest into ricotta cheese and spread evenly across lightly toasted whole-grain bread.
Top with tender flakes of poached salmon and juicy diced sweet orange.
Scatter snipped fresh basil ribbons over top and finish with extra-virgin olive oil and cracked black pepper.
tips: Sweet navel orange adds bright citrus juice without sharpness, pairing wonderfully with rich salmon.
Light toasting keeps the bread warm and structured yet still gentle to chew.

recipes.title: Soft Cumin, Cilantro & Poached Salmon Avocado Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Nourishing morning plate pairing soft-cooked eggs and tender flaked poached salmon with cumin-warmed mashed avocado, fresh cilantro, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Soft-boil or poach eggs for 6 minutes until whites are tender and yolks remain spoonably runny.
Mash ripe avocado on a warm plate with ground cumin, chopped fresh cilantro, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
Nestle flaked poached salmon and warm eggs right over the creamy cumin-cilantro avocado and serve immediately.
tips: Every component on this plate is naturally soft and moist with rich healthy fats.
Ground cumin adds warm depth to avocado without any spicy bite.

recipes.title: Soothing Lemon Balm, Ginger & Sesame Poached Salmon Rice Porridge
recipes.summary: Velvety warm morning rice congee simmered with grated ginger and rice bran oil, gently folded with flaky poached salmon, fragrant lemon balm leaves, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Simmer cooked jasmine rice, vegetable broth, grated fresh ginger, and rice bran oil in a saucepan for 14 minutes until creamy and porridge-soft.
Turn off heat and gently fold in flaked poached salmon for 2 minutes so it warms without breaking up.
Ladle into warm bowls and finish with snipped fresh lemon balm leaves and a drizzle of toasted sesame oil.
tips: Fresh lemon balm lends a calming citrus aroma that lifts warm salmon porridge gracefully.
Ideal when you want a gentle, spoonable, hydrating breakfast.

recipes.title: Soft Rosemary, Sage & Olive-Oil Mashed Potato Bowl with Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Fluffy Yukon gold potatoes whipped with warm olive oil infused with minced rosemary, fresh sage, and black pepper, crowned with moist flakes of gently poached salmon.
steps: Boil diced Yukon gold potatoes in water for 12 minutes until completely tender, then drain well.
Meanwhile warm olive oil over low heat with very finely minced rosemary and sage for 1 minute until fragrant and soft.
Mash hot potatoes with the herb olive oil, warm vegetable broth, and black pepper until cloud-smooth, then spoon into bowls topped with flaked poached salmon.
tips: Olive-oil mashed potatoes stay light, dairy-free, and silky even as they cool slightly.
Top with a soft-poached egg if you want an extra-hearty weekend brunch.

recipes.title: Sumac, Crushed Fennel Seed & Poached Salmon Creamy Cottage Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with cool cottage cheese, finely minced celery stalk, tender flaked poached salmon, lightly crushed fennel seed, ruby ground sumac, and olive oil.
steps: Mix cottage cheese with finely minced celery stalk, finely crushed fennel seeds, and half the olive oil.
Spread the creamy herb-celery mixture generously over warm lightly toasted whole-grain bread.
Arrange flaked poached salmon on top, dust with ruby ground sumac, and finish with the remaining olive oil.
tips: Crushing fennel seeds finely with the back of a spoon releases sweet licorice aroma that pairs classically with salmon.
Ground sumac supplies bright citrus lift with zero squeezing needed.

recipes.title: Saffron, Fennel Seed & Celery Poached Salmon Pearl Barley Soup
recipes.summary: Mediterranean golden broth soup gently poaching tender salmon cubes with soft pearl barley, sweet celery stalks, toasted fennel seed, steeped saffron, and extra-virgin olive oil.
steps: Steep saffron threads in 2 tbsp hot broth while warming olive oil in a pot to soften sliced celery stalks and crushed fennel seeds for 4 minutes.
Pour in remaining vegetable broth, saffron infusion, and cooked pearl barley; simmer gently 6 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Lower heat to a bare simmer, add salmon cubes, and poach uncovered 5 to 6 minutes until just flaky; ladle softly into warm bowls.
tips: Poaching salmon directly in the golden saffron broth infuses every flaky bite with delicate Mediterranean sweetness.
Keep the pot at a bare simmer so salmon stays silky rather than firm.

recipes.title: Sweet Cherry, Fresh Basil & Walnut-Oil Poached Salmon Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright no-cook lunch bowl pairing chilled flaky poached salmon and tender quinoa with halved sweet cherries, diced celery stalk, torn fresh basil, and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Whisk walnut oil and fresh lemon juice together in a mixing bowl.
Fold in cooked quinoa, finely diced celery stalk, halved sweet cherries, and snipped fresh basil.
Divide into two bowls and arrange moist flakes of poached salmon right on top.
tips: Dark sweet cherries and walnut oil elevate leftover poached salmon into a restaurant-worthy lunch in under 10 minutes.
Use thawed frozen cherries out of season for juicy sweetness year-round.

recipes.title: Chilled Fresh Shiso, Ginger & Sesame Oil Poached Salmon Buckwheat Noodles
recipes.summary: Silky cooled soba noodles tossed with flaky poached salmon, grated fresh ginger, aromatic toasted sesame oil, crisp fresh shiso ribbons, and fragrant chopped cilantro.
steps: Boil buckwheat soba noodles 5 minutes until tender, drain, and rinse thoroughly under cool water so they stay silky.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, grated fresh ginger, and 2 tbsp water in a mixing bowl.
Toss cooled noodles with the sesame-ginger dressing, snipped fresh shiso, and chopped cilantro, then crown gently with flaked poached salmon.
tips: Snip cooked soba noodles once in the bowl with shears so portions lift neatly with zero tangling.
Rinsing soba in cold water removes excess starch for a clean, gliding texture.

recipes.title: Halved Grape, Fresh Tarragon & Celery Poached Salmon Yogurt Salad
recipes.summary: Cool, creamy lunch salad combining flaked poached salmon, quartered sweet grapes, finely diced celery stalk, Greek yogurt, fresh tarragon, olive oil, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Stir Greek yogurt, extra-virgin olive oil, chopped fresh tarragon, and cracked black pepper until silky smooth.
Fold in finely diced celery stalk, quartered sweet grapes, and flaked poached salmon with a light hand so chunks stay plush.
Serve immediately over tender butter lettuce leaves or tucked inside soft whole-grain bread.
tips: Greek yogurt plus olive oil gives rich salad-dressing creaminess with far less saturated fat than mayo.
Sweet grapes balance salmon's savory richness beautifully.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric, Nigella Seed & Cumin Poached Salmon Red Lentil Bowl
recipes.summary: Silky split red lentils simmered in rice bran oil with golden turmeric, toasted nigella seed, and earthy cumin, topped with tender flaked poached salmon and fresh cilantro.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat and bloom nigella seeds, ground cumin, and ground turmeric for 45 seconds.
Add rinsed split red lentils and vegetable broth; simmer gently covered 14 minutes until creamy and golden.
Nestle the salmon on top of the simmering lentils, cover 4 minutes to steam through gently, flake gently into bowls, and top with chopped cilantro.
tips: Steaming the salmon right over the simmering lentil pot saves a pan and keeps the fish extraordinarily moist.
Every spoonful blends soft lentils and silky fish with warming spices.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Sumac & Spearmint Poached Salmon Warm Farro Salad
recipes.summary: Sunny Mediterranean lunch bowl layering tender warm farro and poached salmon flakes with juicy sweet orange, ruby ground sumac, cool fresh spearmint, and olive oil.
steps: Whisk olive oil, juice of half the orange, and ground sumac in a mixing bowl.
Toss warm cooked farro with the sumac-orange vinaigrette and snipped fresh spearmint leaves.
Spoon into bowls and top gently with flaked poached salmon and juicy sweet orange segments.
tips: Warm farro absorbs citrus-sumac dressing readily while remaining soft and satisfying.
Swap cooked pearl barley if you prefer an even softer whole grain.

recipes.title: Velvety Squash, Sage & Thyme Soup Topped with Poached Salmon and Pumpkin Seed Oil
recipes.summary: Creamy pureed butternut squash soup steeped with fresh sage, thyme, and black pepper, finished with warm flaky poached salmon and nutty emerald roasted pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Simmer diced butternut squash, vegetable broth, fresh sage leaves, fresh thyme, and cracked black pepper covered 14 minutes until completely soft.
Puree with an immersion blender until velvety smooth.
Ladle hot soup into two bowls, nestle warm flaked poached salmon in the center, and swirl roasted pumpkin seed oil across the top.
tips: Pureed soup cradles delicate poached salmon flakes so every spoonful is lush and effortless to swallow.
Pre-cubed squash keeps preparation quick and friendly on hands.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Celery & Flaxseed-Oil Poached Salmon White Bean Mash
recipes.summary: Creamy warm mashed cannellini beans folded with finely minced celery stalk, fresh lemon balm, chopped tarragon, cold-pressed flaxseed oil, and tender flaked poached salmon.
steps: Warm rinsed cannellini beans with finely minced celery stalk and 3 tbsp water in a small saucepan for 4 minutes until heated and soft.
Remove from heat and mash coarsely with fresh lemon juice, snipped lemon balm, chopped tarragon, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Spoon the silky herb white-bean mash into bowls and crown with warm flaked poached salmon.
tips: Stirring flaxseed oil in off the stove protects its delicate omega-3 oils while giving the bean mash a glossy sheen.
Double omega-3 synergy from salmon and flaxseed oil in a soft, filling midday bowl.

recipes.title: Saffron, Fennel Seed & Sweet Orange Poached Salmon over Pearl Barley
recipes.summary: Tender salmon fillets gently poached in sweet orange juice and broth infused with golden saffron, crushed fennel seed, and extra-virgin olive oil, served over warm pearl barley.
steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and bloom lightly crushed fennel seeds for 30 seconds.
Pour in vegetable broth, fresh orange juice, orange zest, and steeped saffron liquid, bringing to a bare simmer.
Nestle salmon fillets in the golden broth, cover, and poach gently 8 to 10 minutes until moist and flaky; serve over warm pearl barley with pan juices spooned over top.
tips: Gentle citrus-saffron poaching keeps salmon buttery soft all the way through with zero dryness.
Spoon extra saffron-orange broth onto the barley so every bite is luscious.

recipes.title: Soft Parchment-Baked Salmon with Sweet Grapes, Rosemary & Thyme
recipes.summary: Moist parchment-steamed salmon fillets baked with halved sweet red grapes, extra-virgin olive oil, finely minced rosemary, fresh thyme, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 375 F and place each salmon fillet in the center of a large piece of parchment paper.
Surround each fillet with halved red grapes, drizzle with olive oil, and scatter finely minced rosemary, fresh thyme, and cracked black pepper on top.
Fold parchment packets tightly closed and bake 14 to 16 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly with a fork and grapes turn jammy.
tips: Baking in sealed parchment steams salmon in its own herb-grape juices and leaves virtually zero pan cleanup.
Open packets carefully away from your face to enjoy the fragrant steam.

recipes.title: Steamed Salmon with Ginger, Mild Sichuan Pepper, Fresh Shiso & Sesame Oil
recipes.summary: Delicate covered-pan steamed salmon fillets perfumed with julienned fresh ginger, a gentle whisper of ground Sichuan pepper, fresh shiso ribbons, and toasted sesame oil.
steps: Pour vegetable broth into a skillet, place salmon fillets inside, and scatter julienned fresh ginger and mild ground Sichuan pepper over the fish.
Cover tightly and steam over medium-low heat for 9 to 11 minutes until the salmon is silky and flakes softly.
Transfer salmon over warm jasmine rice, spoon aromatic pan juices across, and finish with snipped fresh shiso and toasted sesame oil.
tips: A light pinch of ground Sichuan pepper creates floral citrus perfume without spicy burn.
Steaming over a shallow splash of broth keeps fish impossibly tender.

recipes.title: Mild Turmeric, Cumin & Cilantro Simmered Salmon Coconut Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Velvety mild coconut curry poaching salmon fillets in rice bran oil bloomed with ginger, golden turmeric, cumin, and black pepper, finished with abundant fresh cilantro.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a skillet over medium-low heat and stir grated ginger, ground turmeric, ground cumin, and cracked black pepper for 45 seconds.
Pour in light coconut milk and 1/4 cup water, bring to a bare simmer, and nestle salmon fillets into the golden sauce.
Cover and poach gently 9 to 10 minutes until tender; spoon over warm jasmine rice and shower with fresh chopped cilantro.
tips: Mild aromatic spices create deep comfort without chili heat.
Spoon plenty of golden coconut sauce over the rice for a luscious, soft dinner.

recipes.title: Covered Baked Salmon over Soft Celery, Tarragon & Summer Savory Mash
recipes.summary: Moist covered-dish baked salmon perfumed with fresh tarragon, summer savory, olive oil, and black pepper, served over a silky braised celery stalk and potato mash.

ingredient_details.note: peeled of strings and thinly sliced

steps: Preheat oven to 375 F; simmer diced potatoes and sliced celery stalks in water 13 minutes until fork-tender, then drain and mash with warm vegetable broth, half the olive oil, and half the tarragon.
Place salmon fillets in a baking dish with 2 tbsp water, remaining olive oil, summer savory, and cracked black pepper; cover tightly and bake 13 to 15 minutes until flaky.
Spoon warm celery-tarragon mash onto plates, set tender salmon on top, and finish with the remaining fresh tarragon and pan juices.
tips: Simmering peeled celery right alongside Yukon potatoes yields a remarkably light, aromatic mash.
Covering the salmon baking dish keeps the fish supple from edge to center.

recipes.title: Slow Olive-Oil Poached Salmon with Sweet Orange, Sumac & Fresh Basil
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth salmon gently poached in warm extra-virgin olive oil scented with sweet orange peel, lightly crushed fennel seed, ruby sumac, and torn fresh sweet basil.

ingredient_details.note: 3 wide strips of peel plus juice of half

steps: Warm extra-virgin olive oil gently over very low heat with orange peel strips and crushed fennel seeds for 3 minutes without bubbling.
Nestle salmon fillets into the fragrant warm oil, cover, and gently poach over lowest heat for 11 to 13 minutes until custardy and easily flaked.
Lift salmon onto warm plates, spoon a touch of scented oil and fresh orange juice over top, and finish with ground sumac and torn fresh basil.
tips: Low-temperature olive-oil poaching produces the softest, silkiest salmon texture possible.
Save the strained orange-fennel olive oil in the fridge to drizzle over warm vegetables or grains within 3 days.

recipes.title: Gently Poached Salmon with Warm Sweet Cherry, Sage & Walnut-Oil Glaze
recipes.summary: Moist skillet-poached salmon crowned with a spoon-soft compote of sweet dark cherries, fresh sage, thyme, cracked black pepper, and a nutty drizzle of cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Simmer halved dark cherries, vegetable broth, finely chopped sage, fresh thyme, and black pepper in a skillet for 5 minutes until cherries turn jammy and soft.
Nestle salmon fillets into the ruby cherry liquid, cover, and gently poach 9 to 10 minutes until flaky and moist.
Transfer salmon to warm plates, spoon soft sage-thyme cherries over each fillet, and finish off-heat with a ribbon of walnut oil.
tips: Rich salmon pairs naturally with sweet-tart berries and stone fruit just like classic Pacific Northwest dishes.
Serve alongside creamy polenta or warm farro.

recipes.title: Starry Anise Seed, Sweet Orange & Ginger Broth Poached Salmon with Spinach
recipes.summary: Aromatic evening broth bowl gently poaching salmon fillets and baby spinach in sweet orange juice infused with fragrant anise seed, fresh ginger, toasted sesame oil, and cilantro.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in tea infuser or strained

steps: Simmer vegetable broth, orange juice, orange zest, sliced ginger, and anise seeds (held in a tea infuser) gently for 5 minutes, then remove the infuser.
Slip salmon fillets into the aromatic broth, cover, and poach on low 8 to 9 minutes until silky, tucking baby spinach around the fish for the final minute.
Lift salmon and wilted spinach into deep bowls, ladle warm broth around them, and finish with toasted sesame oil and fresh cilantro.
tips: Using a tea infuser for anise seeds lets you capture all their sweet warmth with zero whole seeds left in the bowl.
Hydrating, brothy, and gentle on digestion in the evening.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Balm, Spearmint & Celery Pearl Barley with Flaked Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Risotto-style creamy pearl barley simmered with tender celery stalk, extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon balm, and cool spearmint, topped with moist flakes of poached salmon.
steps: Soften finely diced celery stalks in half the olive oil over medium-low heat for 4 minutes until tender.
Stir in cooked pearl barley and warm vegetable broth; simmer gently 9 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until thick and creamy like risotto.
Remove from heat, fold in snipped fresh lemon balm, spearmint, and remaining olive oil, then serve in warm bowls topped with flaky poached salmon.
tips: Fresh garden lemon balm and spearmint make rich salmon and creamy barley taste remarkably bright and light.
Keep extra broth handy if you like an extra-creamy spoonable finish.
